name: Twin Fury grants extra Felfury on a critical Annihilan Strike (#4720)
contract: Twin Fury 801892 reads 'Critically striking with Twin Slice or Annihilan Strike now generates an additional 1 Felfury.' felsworn_casts::OnSpellHitResult (AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp) gates this on Twin(info) && Direct(info) && crit. Twin() previously matched only Named(info, 801901) (Twin Slice) or family-20 SpellFamilyFlags[0] bit 1048576; Annihilan Strike's own weapon-hit sub-spells (801913 main hand, 801914 off hand, confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer) carry SpellFamilyFlags[0] = 0, SpellFamilyFlags[1] = 65536 instead - a bit unique to this ability's 9-spell rank chain within family 20 (verified against every family-20 Spell.dbc record). Twin() was therefore unconditionally false for every Annihilan Strike hit, so the Twin Fury bonus never applied to it. The fix adds the SpellFamilyFlags[1] & 65536 check. Annihilan Strike is DmgClass 2 (SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_MELEE, confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer), so its crit roll runs through Unit::MeleeSpellHitResult and Unit::SpellDoneCritChance's SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_MELEE branch, which reads PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE (fed by melee_crit_rating/melee_hit_rating/expertise_rating), not the SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_MAGIC branch's PLAYER_SPELL_CRIT_PERCENTAGE (fed by spell_crit_rating) - the original fixture's spell_crit_rating: 100000 had no effect on this ability's crit chance, leaving Twin Fury's bonus inconsistently applied at base melee crit. Both fixtures now carry melee_hit_rating, expertise_rating and melee_crit_rating at 100000 to guarantee the hit and the crit deterministically. Baseline Felfury generation for Annihilan Strike (rev_20260928 #4665 fix, 1 Felfury per landed weapon hit, unconditional on crit) is identical for both fixtures, so the difference between them isolates Twin Fury's own contribution: with a guaranteed crit on both weapon hits, the control fixture (no 801892) ends with 2 Felfury (baseline only) and the Twin Fury fixture ends with 4 (baseline 2 plus 1 extra per crit weapon hit).
